agent_explanation: Controller-driven body 3 moves upward at ~48 m/s toward thin horizontal wall 1 (h=0.4 at y=11.6). Per-step displacement ~0.88 (dt=0.0184) far exceeds distance-to-wall (0.72 at step 31) so it enters the wall deeply within one step. Impulse plus positional correction with 30 substeps fails to expel it, leaving 0.166 overlap exceeding 0.15 limit. Disabling the controller removes the high-speed drive and the violation disappears.
